cohort: 99 women diagnosed with fetal growth restriction at term at Reina Sofia Hospital, Cordoba, Spain from January 2014 to December 2015
finding: Prostaglandins (dinoprostone and misoprostol) were more effective than Cook's balloon for inducing labor and achieving vaginal birth in women with intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) at term, with a similar safety profile.
mod_finding: Prostaglandins were more effective than Cook's balloon for inducing labor and achieving vaginal birth in women with IUGR at term.
